notes: Access route: direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF/bot-block encountered; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow). Site is Angular/Spartacus on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) with server-rendered nav embedded in the homepage's ng-state JSON (script#ng-state -> cx-state.cms.components.entities.FabHamBurgerComponent.component.navigationNode), which gave the full mega-menu tree with node titles. Exact quantities were sourced from the public OCC REST API (https://apisap.fabindia.com/occ/v2/fabindiab2c/products/search, base URL and endpoint path recovered from main.<hash>.js) using query=:relevancy:allCategories:<category-slug> and reading pagination.totalResults - not the estimate-prone facet widget. For Home Decor, cross-checked that the nav-aligned Category facet's per-value counts summed exactly to the parent's totalResults (508), confirming the facet/leaf-slug counts are exact and mutually exclusive. Every leaf slug query was spot re-verified individually against its expected count (all matched, see evidence). Fabindia is overwhelmingly an apparel/textile brand (Women/Men/Kids ethnic+western wear, Home Linen, Bed linen, Cushions, Curtains, Bath textiles) - all excluded as APPAREL/TEXTILES per scope. Within Home & Living, excluded: Bed linen, Cushions, Curtains, Bath (bath sets/toiletry bags/soap dispensers - functional bath fixtures + textile toiletry bags, not decorative bath accessories), Floor Coverings (Dhurries/Door Mats = textile/rugs, Seating = furniture, Yoga Mats), Storage & Utility (Boxes/Baskets/Carryalls = functional tissue/laundry/utility storage, mostly cotton fabric; Dustbins empty/0), Accessories (Stationery = notebooks, Personal Accessories = fabric/leather jewellery boxes & watch cases, Games & Toys, Travel - none decor), Gifting (Holiday & Gift exclusion). Within Kitchen & Dining, excluded Kitchenware (jars/chopping boards/spice boxes/chapati boxes - kitchen prep/storage, not decor) and Cookware/Table Linen (both 0 products, effectively retired/empty categories). Within Home Decor, excluded Incense & Fragrances (76 - diffusers/incense/oils = Home Fragrance) and, within the mixed 'Candles & Candle Stands' node, the 59 actual scented wax candles (kept only the 23 candle holders/snuffers - see row evidence for the title-by-title split). Rule 0 applied: all Lighting (Table/Floor/Hanging & Wall Lamps, Lampshades) and all Diyas/oil-lamps/lanterns kept in full despite living under a 'Home Decor' merchandising label rather than a literal 'Lighting' node - no bulbs/ceiling fans/wiring present. All mirrors kept: both the Home Decor 'Mirrors & Wall Art' node (14, mixed with framed wall art) and the separate Furniture > Accents > 'Mirrors' node (23, pure wall/floor mirrors) - confirmed via product-title sampling that these are two distinct, non-overlapping category codes/product sets, so both are counted without double-counting. Also checked and skipped a 'decor-mirrors' URL (1 product, a duplicate of an item already in Mirrors & Wall Art, and not reachable from the live hamburger-menu nav tree) to avoid double counting. Duplicate-company determination: Fabindia is a single well-known Indian retailer (fabindia.com); no other S.N. in this project maps to the same brand - not a duplicate.
